---
title: "Bulletins"
---

<img src="images/main_logo.png" class="centered-image">

## Bulletins

Recent bulletins received at GB7CAM, grouped by topic. Bulletins are broadcast
messages relayed across the packet network; they are shown here as received and
attributed to the originating station. Personal mail is never shown.

<style>
.topic-chip { display:inline-block; padding:5px 12px; margin:3px; border:1px solid #cfd8e3;
  border-radius:16px; background:#f2f6fb; color:#1f5b8f; font-family:sans-serif; font-size:0.88em;
  cursor:pointer; user-select:none; }
.topic-chip:hover { background:#e4eef8; }
.topic-chip.active { background:#1f77b4; border-color:#1f77b4; color:#fff; }
.topic-chip .count { opacity:0.7; font-size:0.85em; margin-left:5px; }
.topic-chip.active .count { opacity:0.9; }
</style>

<div style="margin:12px 0 4px; font-family:sans-serif;">
<label for="date-select"><strong>Show:</strong></label>
<select id="date-select" class="search-box" style="width:auto; padding:5px;">
<option value="0">All dates</option>
<option value="1">Today</option>
<option value="3">Last 3 days</option>
<option value="7">Last 7 days</option>
</select>
</div>

<div id="topic-chips" style="margin:8px 0;">Loading topics...</div>

<div style="margin:6px 0 16px; font-family:sans-serif; font-size:0.9em;">
<a id="rss-link" href="https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/bulletins/rss" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>RSS feed &#128248;</strong></a>
<span class="text-muted"> &mdash; paste this URL into a feed reader (Feedly, Thunderbird, NetNewsWire) to follow new bulletins for the selected topic.</span>
</div>

<div id="bulletins-container" class="panel">
  <p>Loading...</p>
</div>

<script>
const BASE = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk";
let currentTopic = "";
let currentSince = "";   // ISO date, or "" for all

function sinceFromDays(days) {
  days = parseInt(days, 10);
  if (!days) return "";
  const d = new Date();
  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - (days - 1));  // "Today" (1) -> today; "3 days" -> today-2
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function fmtDate(iso) {
  if (!iso) return "";
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
  const MON = ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"];
  return `${d} ${MON[m - 1]}`;
}
function esc(s) {
  return (s || "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]));
}

async function loadTopics() {
  const topics = (await (await fetch(BASE + "/bulletins/topics")).json()).topics || [];
  const el = document.getElementById("topic-chips");
  const chip = (topic, label, count) =>
    `<span class="topic-chip${topic === currentTopic ? " active" : ""}" data-topic="${esc(topic)}">` +
    `${esc(label)}${count != null ? `<span class="count">${count}</span>` : ""}</span>`;
  el.innerHTML = chip("", "All", null) + topics.map(t => chip(t.topic, t.topic, t.count)).join("");
  el.querySelectorAll(".topic-chip").forEach(c => {
    c.addEventListener("click", () => {
      currentTopic = c.dataset.topic;
      el.querySelectorAll(".topic-chip").forEach(x => x.classList.toggle("active", x.dataset.topic === currentTopic));
      loadBulletins().catch(console.error);
      updateRss(currentTopic);
    });
  });
}

async function loadBulletins() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (currentTopic) params.set("topic", currentTopic);
  if (currentSince) params.set("since", currentSince);
  params.set("limit", "100");
  const list = (await (await fetch(`${BASE}/bulletins?${params}`)).json()).bulletins || [];
  const el = document.getElementById("bulletins-container");
  if (!list.length) { el.innerHTML = "<p class='text-muted'>No bulletins.</p>"; return; }
  el.innerHTML = list.map(b => `
    <details class="bulletin-item" data-id="${b.id}">
      <summary style="cursor:pointer; padding:6px 0;">
        <span class="text-muted">${fmtDate(b.msg_date)}</span>
        &nbsp;<span class="port--axip" style="font-weight:bold;">${esc(b.category)}</span>
        &nbsp;<span class="text-muted">${esc(b.callsign)}</span>
        &nbsp; ${esc(b.title)}
      </summary>
      <pre class="bulletin-body" style="white-space:pre; overflow-x:auto; background:#f7f7f7; padding:10px; border-radius:4px; margin:6px 0; font-size:0.82em; line-height:1.2; font-family:'Consolas','DejaVu Sans Mono','Menlo','Courier New',monospace;">Loading...</pre>
    </details>`).join("");

  el.querySelectorAll("details.bulletin-item").forEach(d => {
    d.addEventListener("toggle", async () => {
      if (!d.open || d.dataset.loaded) return;
      d.dataset.loaded = "1";
      const pre = d.querySelector(".bulletin-body");
      try {
        const body = (await (await fetch(`${BASE}/bulletins/${d.dataset.id}`)).json()).body || "";
        pre.textContent = body;
      } catch (e) {
        pre.textContent = "(body unavailable)";
      }
    });
  });
}

function updateRss(topic) {
  document.getElementById("rss-link").href =
    topic ? `${BASE}/bulletins/rss?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` : `${BASE}/bulletins/rss`;
}

async function init() {
  try {
    await loadTopics();
    document.getElementById("date-select").addEventListener("change", e => {
      currentSince = sinceFromDays(e.target.value);
      loadBulletins().catch(console.error);
    });
    await loadBulletins();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Bulletins load failed:", e);
    document.getElementById("bulletins-container").innerHTML =
      "<p class='text-muted'>Bulletins unavailable right now.</p>";
  }
}

init();
</script>
